description: Work-package fragnet templates: the activities, logic (FS/SS/FF with lag), durations, materials and quality hold points the deterministic engine instances. This is the structure the admin fragnet editor exposes for editing (ADMIN_SPEC.md section 2). The LLM never emits these - it selects and reasons over them, and the engine instances them (CLAUDE.md rule 2).
provenance_summary: MIXED. The stage / owning department / key materials / key gates structure is transcribed from the DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md section 3 table. The ACTIVITY BREAKDOWNS, DURATIONS, LOGIC LINKS and LAGS are INDUSTRY ESTIMATES sized for a 20 MW-class Tier III build - typical sequences in the right range, not a record of how any project ran. A fragnet whose durations and logic are wrong produces a schedule that is internally consistent and completely wrong, which is harder to catch than an obvious error. This is a starter set establishing the shape; full discipline and commissioning depth is scheduled work, and the real depth should come from the client's historical schedules.

provenance.note:
Transformer-to-UPS installation and test. Switchgear and UPS install dominate; the sequence is gated by delivery, not by labour. Structure from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#3; durations and logic are estimates. --- EXTENDED FOR REVIEW (three additions). c65 DIESEL GENERATOR SET INSTALLATION: lead.generator was in equipment_lead_times at 30 weeks with drives_rfs=true and was consumed by nothing, so the gensets never appeared in any programme and their lead time constrained nothing. It now carries a material link. Owner-furnished gensets (dp.ofe) change WHO procures, not the lead time, so the delivery gate applies either way. c67 BULK HSD STORAGE: the fuel system path.nm.peso_hsd licenses had no activity to gate; PESO is a safety approval for bulk diesel and its absence was a real hole. c70 HV/MV ENERGISATION: the package previously ended at cable termination, so there was no energisation step at all - which meant DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#5 ("energisation cannot precede CEIG approval") had nothing to attach to, and safety.hv_energisation, a Tier-1 entry that BLOCKS EXPORT, matched no activity in any plan ever produced. THREE DURATIONS AND FIVE LOGIC LINKS ARE ESTIMATES. JUDGEMENTS TO CHALLENGE: 15 days for energisation assumes a single energisation event, where a 2N facility energises each path separately; the SS+10 from genset to fuel system assumes one contractor; and c65 hangs off c10 (plinth and pad preparation), which assumes the genset pads are poured with the transformer pads.

ZONE MULTIPLICATION (Tier 2). `zone_kind` repeats this fragnet once per zone of that kind, so a campus with eight data halls schedules eight fit-outs rather than one that stands for all of them. Activities carrying `zone_scope: "project"` are instanced ONCE and are listed with the reason - work that genuinely happens once must not be multiplied, or the plan invents seven fuel farms. The split between per-zone and project-wide is a planner's judgement recorded as data: it is unverified like the rest of this entry, and changing it is a library edit rather than a code change.

--- INVENTED FOR REVIEW - every step below is mine, not transcribed. The PARENT activity and its duration are unchanged; the steps are a decomposition of it, and their durations sum exactly to it (enforced by test_execution_steps.py). So the step DURATIONS move no date: had they summed to anything else, the whole programme would have shifted on the strength of numbers I made up, and that shift would be indistinguishable from a real re-forecast. Re-pointing the material links DOES move dates, deliberately and in the direction of realism - see below - and that is the only thing here that does. Treat the SEQUENCE as the reviewable claim - it is the order these works are actually done in - and the individual day splits as unverified. A planner correcting them should keep the sum, or change the parent duration deliberately.

The decomposition also makes one thing MORE correct rather than merely finer: a delivery now gates only the step that needs the plant. The rigging study for a transformer can be done while the transformer is still in the factory; the offload cannot. Before this, the whole eight-day activity waited on delivery.

MEASURED: decomposing these three deliverables moved RFS from 863 to 840 on the Navi Mumbai brief. Every day of that comes from the delivery re-pointing, not from the step durations. The switchgear base frames, the LV panel positioning and the rigging study no longer wait in a factory queue they were never actually in.

provenance.note:
INVENTED FOR REVIEW. Stage, owning departments (PM, QA/QC) and the gates (occupancy certificate, warranties) are transcribed from docs/DOMAIN_KNOWLEDGE.md#3. The SIX ACTIVITIES, their SIX DURATIONS, the SEVEN LOGIC LINKS and the TWO HOLD POINTS are estimates: about 85 days on the longest path (snagging -> TCCF -> final account). UPTIME TCCF (j30) IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT THIS PROJECT, not a universal step: Tier Certification of Constructed Facility is a demonstration to Uptime Institute after construction, and it applies only where the client is actually pursuing certification. A project building to Tier standards without certifying would delete j30 entirely. Its 20 days covers demonstration and report, not the certification cycle end to end. JUDGEMENTS TO CHALLENGE: TCCF is placed after snag closure and before final account, which assumes a single certification pass - a failed demonstration means remediation and a re-demonstration that this does not model. SCOPE DECISION: this package covers CONTRACTOR work only. The occupancy certificate and final fire NOC are statutory and deliberately absent, because the city pathway data already holds them with their own durations and blocking rules (path.nm.occupancy_certificate 8 weeks blocks handover; path.nm.fire_noc_final 10 weeks blocks occupancy). Duplicating them here would put two numbers for the same approval in two libraries, and CLAUDE.md rules that compliance is versioned data, not fragnet content. NOT MODELLED: the defects liability period itself, typically 12-24 months, which would dwarf the construction programme if drawn as an activity - j60 marks its commencement only.
